📋 **Admission Process at Medicaps University:**

1. Visit our official website and fill out the online application form.
2. Upload required documents (10th, 12th marksheets, ID proof, passport photo).
3. Pay the application fee of ₹500 online.
4. Appear for the entrance test (if applicable for your course).
5. Await your merit list result and confirm your seat.

📅 **Key Dates:**
- Application Opens: April 1st
- Last Date to Apply: June 30th
- Results Announced: July 15th

Would you like to know about specific courses or fees?

✅ **Eligibility Criteria:**

**Undergraduate (B.Tech, BBA, BCA, B.Sc):**
- Passed 10+2 from a recognized board
- Minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for reserved categories)
- Physics, Chemistry & Math for engineering programs

**Postgraduate (MBA, M.Tech, MCA):**
- Bachelor's degree with minimum 55% marks
- Valid score in CAT/MAT/GATE (as applicable)

**Diploma Programs:**
- Passed 10th (SSC) with minimum 45% marks

Want details on a specific course?

🎓 **Courses Offered at Medicaps University:**

**Engineering (B.Tech - 4 years):**
• Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
• Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AIDS)
• Electronics & Communication (ECE)
• Mechanical Engineering (ME)
• Civil Engineering (CE)

**Management:**
• BBA (3 years) | MBA (2 years)

**Computer Applications:**
• BCA (3 years) | MCA (2 years)

**Science:**
• B.Sc (Physics, Chemistry, Math) | M.Sc

**Diploma Programs (2 years):**
• Civil, Mechanical, Electrical

Would you like fee details or placement info for any of these?

| Course | Annual Fees |
|--------|------------|
| B.Tech (CSE/AIDS) | ₹1,20,000 |

**Additional Fees:**
• Registration: ₹500 (one-time)
• Hostel: ₹80,000/year (optional)
• Exam fee: ₹2,000/semester

🎁 **Scholarships available!** Type 'scholarship' to know more.

🏆 **Scholarship Opportunities:**

**Merit-Based Scholarships:**
• 90%+ in 12th → 50% tuition waiver
• 80–90% in 12th → 25% tuition waiver
• University Entrance Rank 1–10 → Full tuition waiver

**Government Scholarships:**
• SC/ST/OBC students: State government scheme applicable
• EWS (Economically Weaker Section): 10% reservation + fee support

**Sports Quota:**
• National/State level athletes get special fee concessions

**How to Apply:** Submit scholarship form during admission with required certificates.

Need help with any specific scholarship category?

🚀 **Placement Highlights (2024):**

📊 **Statistics:**
• Overall Placement Rate: **94%**
• Highest Package: **₹42 LPA** (Google, CSE)
• Average Package: **₹8.5 LPA**
• Total Recruiters: **180+ companies**

🏢 **Top Recruiters:**

• Core: L&T, Tata Steel, BHEL
• Startups: Swiggy, Zomato, BYJU's, Razorpay

📅 **Placement Season:** October – March (final year)

💼 **Training Support:** Aptitude, coding, soft skills & mock interviews provided.

Would you like branch-specific placement data?

🏠 **Hostel & Accommodation:**

**Boys' Hostel:**
• 3 blocks with 800+ beds
• AC & Non-AC rooms available
• Fee: ₹80,000/year (AC) | ₹60,000/year (Non-AC)

**Girls' Hostel:**
• Separate secured campus

• Fee: ₹85,000/year (AC) | ₹65,000/year (Non-AC)

**Facilities Include:**
✅ Wi-Fi | ✅ Laundry | ✅ Mess (vegetarian & non-veg)
✅ Common room | ✅ Indoor games | ✅ Gym

**Mess Fee:** ₹3,500/month (included in above)

📝 **Entrance Exam Details:**

**Medicaps University Entrance Test (MUET):**
• Mode: Online (Computer Based)
• Duration: 2 hours
• Total Marks: 200

**Sections:**
| Section | Marks |
|---------|-------|
| Mathematics / Reasoning | 80 |
| English Proficiency | 40 |
| General Awareness | 40 |
| Subject Specific (optional) | 40 |

**Exam Dates:** Conducted every Sunday in June

**Also Accepted:** JEE Main, CUET, SAT scores (direct admission based on merit)

**Exam Fee:** ₹500 (included in application)

Want tips on how to prepare for MUET?

🏫 **About Medicaps University:**

Medicaps University was established in **1999** and has grown into one of Central India's most respected institutions.

🌟 **Key Highlights:**
• **NAAC A+ Accredited** (2023)

• **10,000+ students** across 40+ programs
• **800+ faculty** members (60% with Ph.D.)
• **₹50 Cr+ research grants** received
• **25,000+ alumni** across 30 countries

**Vision:** To be a globally recognized center for innovation, learning, and excellence.
